painting-mss.reason: The engraving, published in Musters' 1873 book on Patagonia, depicts Tehuelche people on horseback crossing the Río Limay, a documentary-style illustration of the people's dress and horse-culture daily life. It is an outsider's engraving but depicts the ethnic group's own dress, riding gear and lifeways, so it qualifies as documentary imagery.
